withheld.jp: みっつの手が重なった。
withheld.en: Three hands overlapped.

withheld.jp: ひとりは俺。
withheld.en: One was mine,

withheld.jp: ひとりは友貴。
withheld.en: one was Tomoki's,

withheld.jp: ひとりは桜庭。
withheld.en: one was Sakuraba's.

withheld.jp: それほど親しくはなかった。
withheld.en: It was nothing that intimate.
comments: *clicks stopwatch* 4 sentences to denial of tEh gaYz. So damn predictable. -GHS

withheld.jp: 桜庭とは因縁などもあった。
withheld.en: Sakuraba and I had a history together.

withheld.jp: 友貴はウィットの足りない男だった。
withheld.en: Tomoki was a man on insufficient wit.

withheld.jp: 俺は俺で、男の友達なんてはじめてで。
withheld.en: I was being I, for the first time having men as friends.
comments: This would exclude Yutaka, which is not quite true. -GHS

withheld.jp: 違う人間なんだから、関係なんてできないと決めつけてた。
withheld.en: We are... different humans, therefore I arbitrarily decided we could never achieve anything like a connection.
comments: 'Different' can indeed mean 'broken', but also simply the obvious: they are separate individuals. Plus, if you'll notice, two of the three should not have trouble of any sort by the standards of the school. And yet... -GHS

withheld.jp: でも、違った。
withheld.en: But I was wrong.

withheld.jp: 違う人間だからこそ、馬が合うこともある。
withheld.en: Us being different humans can also be the reason why we get on well with each other, as rider and horse fit each other.
comments: See CCD0002. Because it's been used with Taichi and Yutaka, who had close to a literal master/slave relationship in the past, and still got well together up to a point, literal would be important. -GHS

withheld.jp: 三人を結びつけたもの。
withheld.en: One thing bound us three people.

withheld.jp: ……それはエロスだった。
withheld.en: ...that was Eros.

withheld.jp: 部活動の怠惰なる待機時間、不意に桜庭が漏らした、
withheld.en: In the hours of hurried waiting that club activities became, unexpectedly Sakuraba let out a,
comments: Hurry up and wait. Seems to fit, given the random military stuff all the way from CCA0002, and how Misato runs things (by herself as much as possible). -GHS

withheld.jp: 『ブルマって、いいよな』
withheld.en: Sakuraba: 『Buruma are nice, ain't they.』

withheld.jp: という呟きによって友情の花は開いた。
withheld.en: And with that muttering, the bud of the flower of friendship bloomed.
comments: This is both subtle and extraordinarily heterosexual. -GHS

withheld.jp: 俺たちはブルマ世代ではない。
withheld.en: We were not of the Buruma Generation.
comments: Ended a few years before, '96 according to unnamed sources that demand their secrecy (Wikipedia). -GHS

withheld.jp: だからこそ、あの素敵なフェチ衣類に、狂おしいばかりに憧れていた。
withheld.en: And that was exactly why that dreamy Fetish Garment made us go mad with longing.

withheld.jp: だってスパッツとかつまんないんだもん。
withheld.en: 'Cuz ya know, those Spats shorts're sooo boooring and stuff.
comments: Peter Payne wept. Tweaked to google. -GHS

withheld.jp: ということで―――
withheld.en: And that is why---

withheld.jp: 「我ら生まれた日は違えども、（童貞と学校）卒業する時は同じ日、同じ時を願わん」
withheld.en: Trio: "Although we have been born on a different day, we merely wish to graduate (from virginity and school) on the same day and the same time."
comments: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oath_of_the_Peach_Garden 願わん sounds negative, but comparing translation with the original it can't be so. -GHS

withheld.jp: 卒業するその時まで、童貞でいようという誓いだ。
withheld.en: We made a vow in which we were to remain virgins until the time of graduation.

withheld.jp: 抜け駆けはナシ。
withheld.en: No stealing anyone's march.

withheld.jp: 実のところ、俺はこの時点ですでに……。
withheld.en: To tell the truth, by this time I was already...
comments: He had likely had sex with Touko already, so all that happened at the mansion is moot. -GHS

withheld.jp: が、魂的にはチェリーだった。
withheld.en: But in my soul I was still cherry.

withheld.jp: 無問題。
withheld.en: No problems there.

withheld.jp: 後に桜庭はプチインポテンツ、友貴はシスコンだと判明した。
withheld.en: Later, it came to light that Sakuraba had le petite impotence, and Tomoki was a siscon.

withheld.jp: みんな問題を抱えている。
withheld.en: Everyone had their problems.

withheld.jp: けど、構わなかった。
withheld.en: But it didn't matter.

withheld.jp: 要するに俺たちは『約束』をしたかったんだ。
withheld.en: The point was that we wanted to make a Promise.

withheld.jp: 友達ごっこを、したかった。
withheld.en: That we wanted to play pretend-a-friendship.

withheld.jp: 記念すべき喪失式はピーチランドに決まっていた。
withheld.en: The ceremony for that memorable loss was decided to be a trip to the PeachLand.
comments: See CCZRooftop, a play on Peach Garden, above, and Soapland, the whorehouse of the type sometimes referenced... -GHS

withheld.jp: メイトブックという意見もあった。
withheld.en: Matebook was also proposed, too.
comments: ...right around this guy, see CCC0016A. The running gag is that it's supposed to be named after a whorehouse. Since the joke was eviscerated in the console versions, this was replaced with "that is a shop that exists in the City", perhaps recalling CCA0002. -GHS

withheld.jp: 三人の手はいつまでも重なっていて、離れる気配がなかった。
withheld.en: The hands of three kept on overlapping, never showing a sign of parting.

withheld.jp: こうして俺たちは、つるむようになった。
withheld.en: And that was how the three of us began mate-ing.
